body.objective: Couple reverse physics to reverse mathematics and foundational analysis: for level-specific physical conclusions, classify the physical postulates, carrier geometry, infinity commitments, set-existence or choice principles, and logic that are sufficient, necessary, equivalent, or avoidable by reformulation.
depends_on: reverse_physics/reports/PHYSICS-VS-MATH.md and REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEAKENABLE_BASE_V1 as the structural predecessor, imported only at their stated boundaries
FOUNDATIONAL_LITERATURE_LEDGER_V1 as a reproducibly pinned but non-exhaustive seed corpus
an explicit weak base and formal encoding before any necessity, independence, or equivalence promotion
activates: a Krein/Hilbertization choice-strength audit for the Bateman-Turok carrier
a theorem-by-theorem ZF/choice audit of separable observable-algebra and GNS steps
a foundational dependency cut through one certified local Weyl BV result to its first analytic input
an operational-quantum reconstruction cross-audit separating physical postulates from proof-theoretic resources
body.current_gate: FOUNDATIONAL_FIRST_REVERSAL: select one nontrivial theorem actually used by a repository claim, state it over an explicit weak base, and either prove the least choice/comprehension principle sufficient and necessary or certify the first obstruction. A displayed proof's use of a principle is only USED_BY_DISPLAYED_PROOF; an alternate separable, constructive, finite, algebraic, or localic formulation must be checked before necessity is claimed.
body.stop_condition: EITHER one repository-relevant target has a formal dependency DAG and a proved NECESSARY_OVER_BASE plus SUFFICIENT_OVER_BASE classification with an independent separating witness or model; OR an AVOIDED_BY_REFORMULATION result proves that an apparent foundational dependency is representational; OR the exact first obstruction to formalizing the physical postulate and target over a common weak base is certified. The literature atlas alone is a checkpoint, not completion.
body.forbid: treating ZF without Choice, ZF+DC, constructive mathematics, topos-internal logic, predicative mathematics, finitism, and a finite regulator as synonyms; claiming that empirical evidence proves an axiom quantified over arbitrary sets; inferring necessity from a standard proof's use of Zorn, Hahn-Banach, compactness, or a basis theorem; claiming Krein space removes the associated Hilbert topology, completeness, infinity, or Choice; treating finite-dimensional operational reconstruction as a QFT theorem; using a REDUCED-MODE, EUCLIDEAN-SPECTRAL, or literature result as evidence for LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL claims; promoting any atlas edge past its explicit status.
